candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST ReadTimeout, /v1/orders 503, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or logs; pool saturation inferred from client span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5 and idle 0, DependencyUnavailable, propagating to order ReadTimeout, /v1/orders 503, and gateway /v1/checkout 502 (metrics: 16 502s, p95 2425ms). Inventory and payment calls succeed, bounding the fault to the order-postgres path.
